first.text: Stop there. Let me see your hand.
She looks at the ember a long moment. Her jaw works like she's chewing something bitter.
Mara Tollen. Harbormaster. These days that means I count what's left and try not to count what isn't.
If you're what the old songs say, you picked a fine time to wash up.

choice.text: Someone in the net-lofts saw Dunstan leave.
How do we push the fog back?
Where do I find the Keeper?
Pell has the humming pebble now.

what_happened.text: Three months back the Hearthspire went dark. The Snuffing, folk call it, like naming it makes it smaller.
The fog came in behind it. First the net-lofts. Then the smokehouse. People go in to fetch a net and come out not knowing whose net it is.

dunstan.text: My brother. Dunstan. Two weeks ago he walked north into the grey with a lantern and no reason he'd give me.
He's not dead. I'd know. I'd— I think I'd know.

beacon_offer.text: The Gull's Beacon, up on the headland. Every midwinter the Keepers lit it from the Spire, and the fog kept its distance.
There's a Keeper in the village. Brother Aldous. Came off the Spire the night it went out and hasn't been sober since.

choice.text: Why haven't you asked him yourself?

why_not.text: I have. He cries. Maybe he'll talk to someone with fire in their hand.

token.text: Take this. It'll get you past the lads at the net-lofts when the time comes.

where_aldous.text: West side, by the Wrens' old house. Follow the smell of cheap spirits.

pebble_kept.text: When the hum reaches her, Mara's eyes go wet. She hums three notes along with it, stops, frowns.
I knew the rest of that. Yesterday I knew it. Keep it safe, Wakebearer.

pebble_given.text: Pell showed me. Carries it everywhere and hums along all day now. Wrong, mind you, but hums it.
Good of you. That child's got precious little that's their own.

dunstan_chose.text: Hesk? Hesk's been Hushed a month. She doesn't know her own—
You tell her: the lantern, the laughing, coming back for his name.
…That's him. That's exactly him, the great fool.
So the fog didn't take him. He went. He walked in there on purpose and didn't tell me why.
I don't know if that's better. Ask me when I've slept.
